Service Line Specialist AIA (f/d/m)

About the role

As a Senior AI & Analytics Sales Leader, you will make an impact by driving revenue growth and market expansion for Cognizant's Artificial Intelligence & Analytics business across Germany. You will be a valued member of the AI & Analytics leadership team, working closely with Client Partners, Account Executives, Solution Architects, Delivery Leaders, Alliance Partners, and executive stakeholders to accelerate adoption of Agentic AI, Generative AI, Analytics, and Data platforms.

In this role, you will:

- Drive revenue growth by identifying new business opportunities, expanding existing client relationships, and developing strategic plans to increase adoption of AI, Agentic AI, Analytics, and Data solutions across Germany.
- Lead complex sales pursuits from opportunity identification through contract closure, partnering with solution and delivery teams to create compelling business cases and transformation roadmaps.
- Build and maintain trusted relationships with C-suite executives, business leaders, and technology stakeholders to understand business challenges and position innovative AI-led solutions.
- Define and execute market strategies focused on Agentic AI, Generative AI, advanced analytics, and data-driven transformation, incorporating emerging market trends and competitive insights.
- Develop strategic alliances with leading technology partners including Microsoft, AWS, Google Cloud, OpenAI, Anthropic, and other AI ecosystem providers to strengthen market presence and client value.

Work model

We believe hybrid work is the way forward as we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role's business requirements, this is a hybrid position requiring travel to client and Cognizant locations across Germany as needed. Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work-life balance through our various wellbeing programs.

The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on business and client requirements. Rest assured; we will always be clear about role expectations.

What you need to have to be considered

- Experience in technology consulting, business development, sales leadership, or client relationship management with a proven track record of driving revenue growth.
- Significant experience selling AI, Agentic AI, Generative AI, Analytics, Data, and cloud-based transformation solutions to enterprise clients.
- Strong understanding of modern AI technologies, including large language models (LLMs), AI orchestration frameworks, advanced analytics, data platforms, and enterprise AI architectures.
- Experience engaging senior executives and business stakeholders to define transformation strategies, business cases, and innovation roadmaps.
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
- Knowledge of data management, cloud platforms, business intelligence, and enterprise analytics solutions.
- Understanding of responsible AI practices and the implications of the EU AI Act for enterprise AI adoption.
- Fluent German and English language skills.

These will help you stand out

- Experience within Banking & Financial Services, Life Sciences, or other highly regulated industries.
- Knowledge of AI orchestration and agent frameworks such as LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, or similar technologies.
- Experience with leading data and AI platforms including Databricks, Snowflake, Informatica, Qlik, Microsoft Fabric, or comparable solutions.
- Strong commercial acumen, including deal structuring, pricing strategy, contract negotiations, and margin management.
- Demonstrated thought leadership through speaking engagements, industry participation, publications, or market-facing content.
- Experience building and managing strategic technology partnerships and alliance ecosystems.

We're excited to meet people who share our mission and can make an impact in a variety of ways. Don't hesitate to apply, even if you only meet the minimum requirements listed. Think about your transferable experiences and unique skills that make you stand out as someone who can bring new and exciting things to this role.

Working with us

Our people are at the heart of what we do at Baker Hughes. We know we are better when all of our people are developed, engaged and able to bring their whole authentic selves to work. We invest in the health and well-being of our workforce, train and reward talent and develop leaders at all levels to bring out the best in each other.

Working for you

Our inventions have revolutionized energy for over a century. But to keep going forward tomorrow, we know we must push the boundaries today. We prioritize rewarding those who embrace change with a package that reflects how much we value their input. Join us, and you can expect:

- Contemporary work-life balance policies and wellbeing activities
- Comprehensive private medical care options
- Safety net of life insurance and disability programs
- Tailored financial programs

jobs.occupation: Software Engineer (all genders) with a focus on development workflows (Data Engineer)
jobs.description:
The German Climate Computing Centre (DKRZ) is the central simulation and data processing facility for the German climate and Earth system modelling community and one of the leading institutions in this field worldwide. DKRZ not only operates supercomputers of the highest performance class and one of the largest data and archive systems, but also participates in many national and international projects aimed at improving the software and infrastructure for climate modelling. Here we are offering a position as

Software Engineer (all genders) with a focus on development workflows

﻿

Your tasks

DKRZ is heavily involved in the development of ICON and in its transition towards more open, collaborative, and transparent development workflows. In this context, you will help shape and improve the software development environment around ICON, with a focus on making day-to-day development, testing, review, and integration processes more efficient and accessible.

Your work will center on GitLab-based development workflows for ICON, including automation, CI/CD, merge request processes, and developer feedback mechanisms. You will explore and prototype practical ways to support ICON developers with AI-assisted tooling, for example for initial code reviews, CI feedback, test result interpretation, documentation support, or guidance during development.

A further focus will be the improvement of ICON’s CI infrastructure, including the use of Jacamar and container-based execution environments. You will contribute to more reproducible, maintainable, and user-friendly build and test workflows that support both established ICON developers and new contributors.

﻿

Qualifications / Experiences

- Academic degree in computer science, applied mathematics, computational physics/engineering, or a related field with a clear focus on scientific computing
- Interest in applying AI-assisted tools to software development, testing, review, and automation
- Experience with scientific software development, especially with code development workflows of shared open-source projects
- Experience with software development workflows in GitLab, including merge requests, code review, and CI/CD, ideally including designing these
- Practical knowledge of container-based development, build, and test environments
- Familiarity with CI runners, preferably including Jacamar or similar HPC-oriented runner setups
- Programming experience under Unix/Linux, including scripting languages such as Python or Bash, experience with HPC environments and programming is an advantage
- Motivation to support open, collaborative, and community-oriented software development
- Very good communication skills and knowledge of English

Employment conditions

We offer work in interdisciplinary teams and excellent connections to national and international research networks. In addition to specific implementation and support requirements from our users and project partners, your work will be characterised by the freedom to work creatively at the interface between applied computer science and the development of tools for scientific applications. Participation in international conferences, project meetings and hackathons enables further training and presentation of your own results wherever meaningful.

We are based in Hamburg, but want to create a suitable working environment by offering flexible working hours and location (up to 100% work from home within Germany). Remuneration will be based on the candidate's qualifications according to TVöD-Bund. You can ideally start already in July 2026, but the exact starting date can be agreed individually. The position is financed by third-party funded projects and is initially limited until March 2028.

Interested applicants are requested to compile a single pdf document containing a cover letter, a detailed CV and any additional documents (e.g. professional references). Applications must be submitted via the portal https://dkrz.softgarden.io/en/vacancies.

﻿

Application deadline: Open until filled. Priority will be given to applications received by 12 July 2026.

Questions? Dr. Jan Frederik Engels (engels@dkrz.de) and Dr. Hendryk Bockelmann (bockelmann@dkrz.de) will be happy to answer them in advance.

Job Description

Earlier this year (March 2026), Unilever announced an agreement to separate our Foods business. Our Foods business, including brands such as Hellmann's and Knorr, will join forces with McCormick to become a global flavour leader, with leading positions across spices, seasonings, condiments and complementary food categories, supported by a strong retail and food service platform. McCormick has 135+ years of heritage, a presence in 150+ countries and territories, and a portfolio of trusted brands. The transaction remains subject to consultation, regulatory approvals and other customary closing conditions with a targeted deal close of mid-2027.

JOB PURPOSE

This role exists to act as a key link between global, regional, and local stakeholders, providing broad cross-functional exposure and fostering collaboration across Unilever and the future separated Foods business.

You’ll be part of a team that believes in doing work that matters — for people and the planet.

Because here, we don’t just hire for jobs. We invite you to be part of something bigger.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

- Lead and coordinate a major business transformation initiative in Germany.
- Track milestones, manage dependencies, and resolve roadblocks.
- Coordinate transition services planning and costing with local and global stakeholders.
- Support knowledge transfer and data migration activities.
- Act as the main point of contact for project escalations and issue resolution.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Finance, HR, Operations) to ensure timely delivery of key milestones.
- Engage with local, regional, and global stakeholders to drive alignment and project success.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Bachelor’s degree in business administration, management, finance or economics.
- Experience working within a large, complex, matrix organization.
- Strong project management and stakeholder management skills.
- Ability to work effectively across functions and seniority levels.
- Excellent communication, influencing, and alignment skills.
- Strong problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
- Proven ability to drive results through teams without direct line management responsibility.
- Excellent German and English communication skills, both written and spoken.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Experience in PMO, business transformation, separation, integration, or large-scale change projects.
- Experience working with senior regional and global stakeholders.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU:

- 38-hour work week with flexible hours and the option for remote work
- 30 days of vacation plus December 24th and 31st off
- Meal allowance: €65 per month
- Access to Manager Check‑Ups – Optional executive‑level health screenings to support long‑term well‑being and performance
- Company pension & shares
- In-house café: snacks, lunch, and coffee specialties at discounted prices
- Discounts via Corporate Benefits
- Deutschland Ticket: €50 monthly subsidy or a discounted company bike
- Free training opportunities and access to our own learning platform
- E-GYM/Wellpass for €20 per month & free corporate health management & a 24/7 counseling service
- And the best for last – unlimited ice cream!

For our location in Hamburg we are seeking:

Postdoctoral researcher

Limited: 2 years | Start: 01.12.2026 | ID: FHPO008/2026 | Deadline: 30.09.2026 | Full-time/Part-time | Remote work possible

DESY, with more than 2900 employees at its two locations in Hamburg and Zeuthen, is one of the world's leading research centres. Its research focuses on decoding the structure and function of matter, from the smallest particles of the universe to the building blocks of life. In this way, DESY contributes to solving the major questions and urgent challenges facing science, society and industry. With its ultramodern research infrastructure, its interdisciplinary research platforms and its international networks, DESY offers a highly attractive working environment in the fields of science, technology and administration as well as for the education of highly qualified young scientists.

The particle physics programme of DESY includes strong contributions to the LHC experiments at CERN and the preparation of future experiments. The experimental programme is enhanced by collaboration with a strong theory group. The DESY ATLAS group is involved in data analyses focusing on W and Z production, Higgs, top quark and Beyond Standard Model physics. In addition the group is involved in the operation of the ATLAS detector and developments for future upgrades, such as the ATLAS silicon strip tracker for the High Luminosity LHC. A new Emmy Noether group within the ATLAS group will be addressing limitations to the measurement of total Higgs boson decay rates by scrutinizing some of the foundational assumptions underlying these measurements and identifying areas where these assumptions can be reevaluated or relaxed. We are Hiring a postdoc to join the new Emmy Noether group and contribute to these measurements.

About your role:

- Higgs boson width determination using H->ZZ events
- Tests of the stability of the measurement with respect to various assumptions, specifically looking into the effect of several free parameters
- Perform EFT fits to constrain potential BSM effects
- Daily supervision of students working on these topics
- Contributing to the performance studies of ATLAS

About you:

- PhD in experimental particle physics
- Experience in the analysis of big data
- Familiar with EFT frameworks (specifically event generation with EFT models)
- Familiar with statistical analysis tools
- Able to handle combinations of different particle physics measurements
- Excellent English skills

Good reasons to join:

Look forward to a unique working environment on our international research campus. Respectful cooperation and the well-being of our DESY employees are particularly important to us. Gender equality is an important aspect for us. To support work life balance we offer flexible working hours, variable part-time, job-sharing models and participation in mobile work (up to 50%). You will benefit from our family-friendly and collegial atmosphere, our established health management and occupational pension provision. As a public funded employer, we offer you a secure workplace and facilitate your individual career with our comprehensive training and development opportunities. Remuneration is according to the regulations of the TV-AVH. DESY offers its employees a financial supplement for a German job ticket (Deutschland-Ticket) at both locations.

For further information please contact Dr. Martina Ojeda at atlas-contact@desy.de

Please submit your complete application documents (letter of motivation and research interests, CV, list of publications, relevant certificates and three letters of references). Please use our online tool for the submission of the letters of reference: Additional application documents (https://www.desy.de/career/additional_application_documents/index_eng.html)

We look forward to receiving your application via our application portal:

Apply now (https://www.desy.de/career/online_application/index_eng.html?p=18404:10:0&jobid=FHPO008/2026&P_LANG=en)

The professional development of women (https://www.desy.de/career/working_at_desy/what_we_offer/equal_opportunities/index_eng.html)  is very important to us and therefore we strongly encourage women to apply for the vacant position.
